gate: A — every tier below is a PROPOSAL awaiting human confirmation. Severity and priority are the researcher's call, not mine. Nothing here is applied to the board or to round-2 scope until a person accepts it.
scope: The 76 blanks the mechanical pass left UNRANKED (tier 6) in round2-capture-ranked.json, ranked by which decision each one unblocks. No web research; every judgement is from files on disk.

tier_vocabulary.source: round2-capture-ranked.json § rule — reused verbatim so the two lists merge
tier_vocabulary.1: would corroborate a conclusion that is still alone after Phase 1 (rec-1, pain-2, pain-3, pain-10)
tier_vocabulary.2: falls in a category with zero observations anywhere: error, no-results, offline states
tier_vocabulary.3: would confirm or kill a class-B proposal (phase2-triage.json § class_b_proposals)
tier_vocabulary.4: deepens a conclusion the board already rests weight on

method.named_beneficiary_rule: Tiers 1, 3 and 4 name the conclusion or proposal served. A row with no named beneficiary is tier 5, by rule, even where the blank is interesting.
method.tier_1_test: Applied as the worked example sets it: the blank must be the corroboration test for rec-1, pain-2, pain-3 or pain-10 that the round wrote down and did not run. Topic adjacency is not enough. Phase 1's own gradings were used as the boundary — mechanism-only corroboration (F28 price alerts, F36 tracker) was graded 'partially' there, and blanks of that shape are NOT tier 1 here unless the capture itself names the unrun test.
method.merging: Blanks that name one capture task in different words are merged into one row. merged_from lists every source blank verbatim with its capture path. 60 rows carry 76 source blanks.
method.superseded: Ten source blanks across six rows were closed later in the same round by a subsequent capture. Those are ranked 5 with the closing capture named — they are not gaps, they are stale entries in a not_observed list. Two further rows (R06, R22) are partially closed; the open half is stated and ranked.
method.pain_2_note: No blank among the 76 tests pain-2 (an enabled-but-inert primary control). The funnel blanks that would have are in the mechanical pass's tier 1, not in this set. Stated rather than forced.

counts.reconciliation: 5+1+18+19+17 = 60 rows. 7+1+20+26+22 = 76 source blanks, matching unranked-76.json exactly. 35+19+3+3 = 60 rows by effort.

assumptions: Assumption — 'Would corroborate' is judged at the same strictness Phase 1 used on itself. Mechanism-only evidence (a product that watches something and pushes a message) was graded 'partially' there and is not tier 1 here. Applying a looser test would manufacture tier 1s.

Assumption — A blank is treated as CLOSED only when a later capture in the same round names the same surface and produces a finding from it. Ten source blanks across six rows meet that test (R04, R05, R21, R33, R47, R59). Where the closure is partial (R06 Airbnb Experiencias vs Servicios; R22 Google flights vs vacation rentals), the open half is stated and ranked, not absorbed.

Assumption — Effort is the cheapest capture that would answer the blank, not the fullest. 'authenticated' means an account is required; 'blocked' means a human decision is required before effort is worth spending (a consent wall, an app gate, or a research-ethics call), not that the work is large.
Assumption — Class-B proposals are unmade conclusions, so 'confirm or kill' is read literally: a tier 3 row is one whose result changes what the proposal would say, not one that adds colour to it.

Assumption — I did not open 45 of the 50 capture files. Five were opened where wording was insufficient. Rows judged from the blank's wording plus the Phase 1 and Phase 2 artifacts could in principle be re-ranked by someone who opens the rest, and six such rows are listed in could_not_judge.

One-sidedness carried forward — Phase 1's closing note applies to this backlog too: research/evidence-ledger.json holds zero records, so no amount of competitor capture makes any of these pain points a traveller's report of being harmed. Every tier 1 here makes an OBSERVATION sturdier. Only Phase 1 fieldwork makes it a user problem.
